cs.t: I used to swap between bicycle and public transit. I had a bag made for me from  https://northstbags.com , which was in my neighborhood. The bag doubled as backpack or pannier. During some commutes, i would swap modes during transit. Pannier/backpack combo met my needs! You have a different requirement set, but my bag delighted me. Aside, i had a medical issue in 2021. While at the doctors office, one of the medical staff swung by and said that she personally fabricated the bag on my back. It meant a lot to me to be able to tell her how grateful I was for it! She had pride in her craftsmanship, and indeed it was excellent.
